title: Measuring Coherence in Predictive Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.20325v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many sequential decision-making procedures, such as active learning, implicitly assume that a model's current predictions agree with those it expects to make after updating on new data, a property we call coherence. Most models in use do not update by exact conditioning and are not guaranteed to be coherent, which can lead to worse decisions. Yet there is currently no general way to measure incoherence or to tell when it matters. We develop tools to measure incoherence and characterise when it affects decisions. We introduce the incoherence ratio, an MMD-based measure of how far any updating procedure departs from coherence, computed only from the procedure's own predictions and updates, and accompany it with an anytime-valid test of coherence. In Bayesian experimental design, acquisition objectives that are equivalent for coherent models choose different data under every approximate model we study, and the incoherence ratio tracks how

translated_title: 衡量预测模型中的连贯性
translated_abstract: 许多顺序决策过程（如主动学习）隐含地假设模型的当前预测与它在根据新数据进行更新后预期做出的预测相一致，我们将这一性质称为连贯性。大多数实际使用的模型并不通过精确的条件化进行更新，因此不保证具有连贯性，这可能导致更差的决策。然而，目前尚无通用的方法来衡量不连贯性，也无法判断它何时会产生影响。我们开发了衡量不连贯性的工具，并刻画了它何时会影响决策。我们提出了“不连贯性比率”，这是一种基于MMD的度量方法，用于衡量任何更新过程偏离连贯性的程度，且仅从该过程自身的预测和更新中计算得出，同时我们还提供了一个随时有效的连贯性检验方法。在贝叶斯实验设计中，对于连贯模型而言等价的采集目标，在我们研究的每一个近似模型下都会选择不同的数据，而不连贯性比率能够追踪这种……
tldr: 本文提出了基于MMD的“不连贯性比率”来衡量模型更新过程偏离连贯性（即当前预测与更新后预期预测的一致性）的程度，并刻画了不连贯性何时会影响诸如主动学习和贝叶斯实验设计等顺序决策。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an MMD-based "incoherence ratio" to measure how far a model's updating procedure departs from coherence (agreement between current and expected post-update predictions), and characterizes when incoherence affects sequential decisions such as active learning and Bayesian experimental design.
